title: Integrated Goal Mesh and Initiative Accountability Matrix
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Objective: create a repeatable, company-level framework that maps strategic goals to cross-functional initiatives, clarifies ownership and escalation paths, and provides an automated heatmap and scoring rollup in Redwood Console. The "Goal Mesh" is a conceptual model that treats objectives as nodes and initiatives as weighted edges. Each initiative contributes to one or more objectives with a declared contribution type (adoption, reliability, cost, latency, compliance) and a numeric weight. The Accountability Matrix is a concise RACI-inspired table extended with a Decision Ladder and a primary/secondary owner per initiative to ensure continuity during rotations.

Scope: 1) Define the Goal Mesh data model and scoring rubric; 2) Build an Accountability Matrix template and team playbook for initiative planning and handoffs; 3) Implement a lightweight automation pipeline to ingest initiative status and metric rollups into a Console dashboard heatmap; 4) Run a pilot across Platform, Serving Runtime, and Console teams in Q2 and iterate.

Out of scope: Full company automated OKR scoring from all external tools, heavy analytics beyond summarized rollups, or changes to compensation/bonus frameworks.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Goal Mesh spec published and reviewed by PM/Eng/Design; 2) Accountability Matrix template accepted and used in at least 4 cross-functional planning sessions; 3) Heatmap dashboard in Console auto-updates from Linear statuses and metrics for pilot initiatives; 4) Pilot retrospective with decision to expand, pivot, or shelve the approach.
success_metrics: - Pilot adoption: 4+ initiatives using the matrix by end of Q2; - Time-to-decision: reduce cross-functional gating cycles by 25%; - Visibility: 90% of company leadership can see initiative-to-objective rollup in Console heatmap; - Quality: stakeholder satisfaction >= 7/10 in post-pilot survey.
deliverables: - Goal Mesh RFC (Confluence) with scoring examples and data schema; - Accountability Matrix template (sheet + exportable JSON); - Heatmap dashboard in Redwood Console; - Playbook: how to run an alignment workshop and monthly cadence; - Pilot retrospective notes and next-steps decision record.
timeline: March: finalize RFC and matrix template. April: integrate metrics sources and build initial dashboard. May: run pilot across Platform, Serving Runtime, Console. Early June: retrospective and roll/stop decision. End of June: decision and next-phase plan ready for roadmap sync.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Overweighting quantitative metrics that favor engineering-visible work. Mitigation: Include qualitative check-ins in matrix and require PM sign-off on weight choices. Risk: Data gaps for metric rollups. Mitigation: fall back to status-based contributions and add telemetry export tickets (ENG-1842). Risk: Too high overhead for teams. Mitigation: provide a one-click matrix import and lightweight defaults for early adoption.
automation_tasks: - Add telemetry export hooks for latency/cost/adoption signals (ENG-1842). - Build Linear -> Console sync for initiative status and owner fields. - Implement scoring engine that normalizes and aggregates weights to objective rollups. - Create dashboard widgets and email summary cards for monthly leadership review.
